title: Upload validation: original assertion and regression retest
interpretation: The unchanged original spoof-rejection assertion now passes. This focused execution contains 18 passing tests; genuine PDF/image uploads and the size boundary are also verified. Earlier failure remains Figure 6.2.

title: Real Flutter web submits a genuine bundled PDF
interpretation: The real Flutter UI completed its multipart upload after the web-platform fix. The actual API returned 201 and stored the bytes in PostgreSQL; two remaining genuine attachments were supplied through the API.

title: Real React clerk performs human review
interpretation: React uses ClerkId rather than UserId to display the assigned case. The actual human-review status action returned 200 and changed request 12 to COMPLETED.

title: Flutter reads the completed result from the API
interpretation: Flutter displays COMPLETED after fetching the real API. Independent SQL confirms request 12, clerk 1 and three binary attachments totalling 7,667 bytes. Actual FastAPI clerk ranking preceded explicit human assignment; Gemini was not used.

title: k6 retest against actual PostgreSQL-backed endpoints
interpretation: Two virtual users over 15 seconds produced 120 requests and zero HTTP errors. Four measured p95 values are below 200 ms in this local synthetic scope. The pre-fix failing run and raw samples remain in the package.

title: Native expanded ZAP report after schema repair
interpretation: Actual Staging API/PostgreSQL target; passive scanning plus finite manual probes. Nine Low missing-nosniff instances and one Informational alert remain. Scan completion is not proof of absence of vulnerabilities.

title: Final xUnit execution on the tested source
interpretation: 328 total: 326 passed, zero failed, two skipped. Real PostgreSQL migration/rollback tests are included. Coverlet raw line coverage is 81.11%, affected by generated migrations; non-migration distinct source lines are 57.82%.
